author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
- Introduced a new section on Type Patterns covering component props, polymorphic components, discriminated unions, form types, theme tokens, and utility types.
- Added a detailed guide on custom React Hooks including useDebounce, useClickOutside, and useAsync with examples and use cases.
- Created a collection of string utility functions such as toKebabCase, truncate, slugify, and toTitleCase, along with usage examples and performance considerations.

Relates to TASK-025 on #874.
title: feat(docs): add documentation for Type Patterns, React Hooks, and String Utilities
